summary: Add native inference streams with cancellation feedback and proxy delivery (S6)

delivery.outcome: Native incremental inference with bounded backpressure, attributed terminal receipts, explicit cancel/restart feedback and live OpenAI/Ollama proxy delivery.
nonGoals: No tool execution, automatic paid restart, prefix resume, cache replay or adaptive/CLI streaming.
No atomic code-patch authority, whole-Forge performance claim, S7 repair or PyPI release.

architecture.decision: Compose existing complete/_complete_route and provider request builders with a policy-validated stream worker. A bounded pipe/queue carries provisional native events. Existing native writers acknowledge final success/error/cancel; no inference retry after provider output. Proxy adapters consume the same interface and controller feedback never changes acceptance.
interfaceChanges: Add stream_complete, immutable StreamEvent/capabilities/feedback/metrics and incremental proxy event formatting with final native receipts.
architecture.rollback: Revert the additive stream facade/worker and proxy streaming branch; preserve complete(), native persistence and existing non-streaming contracts.
